author: Leon Made This / s010s

description.en: Original stylized whole living Encrinus with ten stout pinnulate arms, a shallow bowl cup and a restored jointed stalk. Complete stalk length, basal attachment, unseen anatomy, nominal dimensions and colour remain artistic or unknown; no exact fossil measurement or comparative Seirocrinus claim.
description.zh: 原创风格化完整 Encrinus，具有十条粗壮羽状腕、浅碗杯和复原分节柄；完整柄长、基部附着、未知解剖、名义尺寸和颜色为创作或未知，不宣称化石精确测量或 Seirocrinus 比较结论。
